name: Single-cell-embedding-benchmark
description: Benchmarks embedding methods for single-cell (e.g., scRNA-seq) data integration and representation quality. It evaluates how well embeddings preserve biological cell-type structure, correct batch effects, and support downstream tasks like clustering and cell-type annotation. Typical evaluations compare clustering agreement, neighborhood preservation and classification performance across methods.
evaluation_method: Adjusted Rand Index (ARI), Normalized Mutual Information (NMI), silhouette score, k-NN classification accuracy and batch-mixing metrics
reputation: A niche benchmark adopted by computational single-cell researchers for evaluating embedding and integration methods; modest community usage.
